# Vendored FSRS scheduler

`ts-fsrs-6.0.0.js` is the unmodified `dist/index.umd.js` from the published ts-fsrs 6.0.0 npm archive. Its complete runtime is embedded in the standalone vocabulary page. The accompanying license is MIT.

Source: https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/ts-fsrs
Archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/ts-fsrs/-/ts-fsrs-6.0.0.tgz

The archive SHA-512 was verified against the registry integrity field during installation. The wrapper uses FSRS-7, standard weights, 90% retention, 1m/10m learning steps, 10m relearning, no fuzzing, and a 36,500-day maximum interval. No optimizer, CDN, or Node runtime is needed to study in the browser.
